## Substantial labs (Agentic Learning Loop)

Substantial, judgement-building labs follow the
[Agentic Learning Loop](https://github.com/open-engineering-conventions/agentic-software-engineering-conventions):
`Predict → Delegate → Observe → Compare → Generalize → Validate → Internalize`.

Courses teach; Labs train engineering judgement. Small exercises do not
require the loop — do not expand a short exercise into a seven-section Lab
for structural consistency. When a Lab follows the loop, declare it in
`metadata.yaml` under `learning:`.

## OELS authoring

Labs copied from this template inherit the shared Open Engineering
Language Server (OELS) authoring contract. Lab `metadata.yaml` and
files under `downloads/` (Kubernetes manifests, Crossplane resources,
Home Assistant snippets, topology data, JSON payload samples, and
`verify.sh` scripts) are intentionally **not** recognized as OE
resources today — OELS ignores them silently, which is the correct
behavior. See the **OELS authoring integration** section of
[`templates/README.qmd`](../README.qmd) for the full artifact
classification table, local stdio/LSP usage, diagnostics-vs-Quarto
guidance, and troubleshooting.
